text: {"entries":[{"name_han":"太上洞玄灵宝智慧定志通微经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that access to subtle Dao is gated by a fixed, undivided will: without定志,智慧 remains discursive and cannot通微. It argues that moral-intellectual clarity is not a product of more knowledge but of stabilizing intention so that the mind ceases to scatter, allowing the Dao to disclose itself. Therefore cultivation is primarily a technology of volitional concentration, not of doctrinal accumulation.","logic_chain":"1) The subtle (微) is real but not available to a fluctuating mind. 2) Fluctuation arises from unsettled will (志不定), which multiplies desires and opinions. 3) Wisdom (智慧) only functions as a path when it settles will rather than multiplies concepts. 4) Once will is fixed, cognition becomes penetrative rather than reactive. 5) Penetrative cognition yields通微: alignment with the Dao’s fine causal structure. 6) Conclusion:定志 is the necessary causal condition of true wisdom, not its optional byproduct.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi, treat day-master and用神 as the ‘定志’ axis: first fix the chart’s governing intention before stacking secondary remedies. 2) Daily cultivation: one vow + one practice window (e.g., morning stillness) to train non-scattering will. 3) When reading a chart crisis, ask ‘what intention is unstable?’ rather than only ‘what element is weak.’ 4) Use meditation/recitation to reduce multi-directional desire before adjusting luck pillars or rituals. 5) Journal one fixed life aim for a full luck cycle and test whether scattered choices correlate with pattern failure.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure cosmology texts that explain how the Dao generates the world, this scripture explains the epistemic precondition for knowing that cosmology. It differs from later morality ledgers by locating the bottleneck in will-stability rather than in external merit accounting. Its logic is closer to contemplative Lingbao than to bureaucratic star-registration scriptures."},{"name_han":"文昌帝君孝经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that filial piety is not merely social etiquette but a cosmic causal law linking personal destiny, literary-official success, and moral credit. It argues that disorder in the parent-child bond disrupts the same hierarchical pattern that governs Heaven’s bureaucracy, so unfilial conduct self-sabotages fate. Therefore Wenchang’s patronage of scholarship is conditional on孝 as the root virtue that authenticates a person before Heaven.","logic_chain":"1) Heaven’s order is hierarchical and reciprocal (Heaven–human, parent–child). 2) The parent–child bond is the nearest enactment of that hierarchy. 3) Violating孝 is not private rudeness but rupture of cosmic pattern. 4) Rupture produces karmic and bureaucratic demerit (blocked luck, failed advancement). 5) Restoring孝 restores alignment and opens Wenchang’s literary-official grace. 6) Conclusion: destiny correction begins at the ethical root of filial relation, not at talent alone.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi career/exam cases, audit family virtue and unresolved filial debt before only boosting ‘print/resource’ elements. 2) Remediation sequence: repair parent relation / ancestral rites → then study discipline → then Wenchang ritual. 3) Treat literary stars (文昌等) as activated by moral fitness, not as pure technical markers. 4) For clients seeking fame, prescribe concrete孝 acts (care, apology, ancestral offering) as fate work. 5) Read official/academic setbacks as possible hierarchical misalignment signals.","logic_compare":"Unlike the Beidou life-extension corpus, which registers fate in stellar bureaus, this text roots fate change in kinship ethics. It differs from generic Confucian孝 texts by making Wenchang a Daoist-administrative guarantor of success. Its logic is moral-causal rather than geomantic or purely contemplative."},{"name_han":"太上老君虚无自然本起经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that existence originates from虚无 and operates by自然: creation is not forced craftsmanship but spontaneous arising from emptiness. It argues that if the root is empty-natural, then forcing form, fame, or power contradicts the generative principle and produces distortion. Therefore true origin-work is returning to non-contrivance, not manufacturing more structure.","logic_chain":"1) What has a beginning must have a prior condition. 2) The prior condition of forms cannot itself be a fixed form, or regress continues. 3) Hence root is虚无: open potential without rigid identity. 4) From that root, arising is自然—unforced, pattern-true. 5) Human striving that violates spontaneity creates false starts and karmic knots. 6) Conclusion: origin recovery = emptiness-aligned non-contrivance.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi, diagnose over-control: when charts or lives are ‘over-engineered,’ restore flow before adding more 补泻. 2) Cultivation: practice wuwei intervals—act only when qi is ready, not from anxiety. 3) For natal reading, privilege spontaneous constitution (day-master ecology) over client wish-projection. 4) Use emptiness meditation to reset desire-driven luck chasing. 5) Prefer remedies that remove obstruction over remedies that force outcomes.","logic_compare":"Compared with ritual-registration scriptures (五斗、北斗), this is ontological rather than bureaucratic. It differs from change-focused texts by asking ‘what is the origin?’ not ‘how do forms transform?’ Its force is metaphysical grounding for all later practice."},{"name_han":"老子变化经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that change is the operative law of the Dao: identity is processive, so clinging to fixed form is ignorance of reality’s mechanism. It argues that sagehood consists in riding transformations rather than freezing a preferred state. Therefore longevity and power come from plasticity aligned with Dao, not from resisting flux.","logic_chain":"1) Observed world continuously transforms. 2) If Dao were static substance only, it could not generate or govern change. 3) Therefore Dao’s efficacy is变化. 4) Beings fail when they reify temporary phases as permanent selves. 5) Aligning with transformation yields survival, efficacy, and spiritual mobility. 6) Conclusion: mastery = lawful participation in change, not escape from it.","logic_practice":"1) Read BaZi as phase dynamics (大运/流年) not as a frozen personality label. 2) Teach clients to change strategy at luck-pillar boundaries rather than force old methods. 3) Cultivation: practice form-shifting methods (breath, posture, role) without losing center. 4) In remedy design, prefer adaptive protocols over one-shot talismans. 5) Track life as transformation sequences: what must die for the next phase to live.","logic_compare":"Unlike本起经’s focus on origin-from-emptiness, this text focuses on mid-stream metamorphosis. It differs from pure ethics scriptures by treating change itself as soteriological technology. Relative to geomancy, it interiorizes flux as spiritual law rather than landscape law."},{"name_han":"道德真经四子古道集解","logic_thesis":"This text proves that the Dao De Jing’s authority is recovered through a multi-master ‘ancient way’ hermeneutic: truth is clarified by convergent classical commentary, not private novelty. It argues that later distortions are corrected by returning to four-lineage collective reading that preserves the old path. Therefore orthodoxy is a disciplined interpretive community practice.","logic_chain":"1) Core scripture can be misread when isolated from living transmission. 2) Multiple classical masters preserve different angles of one Dao. 3) Collective collation filters sectarian drift and linguistic decay. 4) Convergent sense across four masters indicates ‘古道’. 5) Practice guided by that reconstructed sense is more reliable than fashionable exegesis. 6) Conclusion: interpretive fidelity is itself a cultivation method.","logic_practice":"1) When applying Laozi to BaZi ethics, cross-check at least two classical commentarial lines before modern self-help readings. 2) Build a personal ‘four-source’ rule: classic + commentary + practice log + outcome. 3) Reject chart theories that cannot be traced to coherent Dao principles. 4) Use collective study (lineage/group reading) to prevent solo delusion. 5) Treat textual study as jing-qi-shen work: quiet mind → parse → embody.","logic_compare":"Unlike single-revelation Lingbao or star scriptures, this is meta-textual: it argues how to read. It differs from apocryphal spell texts by locating power in interpretive discipline rather than mantra efficacy. Its uniqueness is orthodoxy-as-method."},{"name_han":"太上三五禹步经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that ritual locomotion (禹步) is a causal technology: the body can enact cosmic numerology (三五) and thereby re-order spiritual space. It argues that stepping patterns are not theater but encoded correspondence between human movement and celestial-terrestrial grids. Therefore right pace and sequence can bind demons, open paths, and align qi.","logic_chain":"1) Cosmos has measurable patterns (three-five numerology, directions, gates). 2) Human body can map those patterns through structured movement. 3) Mapping is not symbolic only; it establishes operational correspondence. 4) Operational correspondence reallocates spiritual authority in a space. 5) Thus禹步 can constrain chaotic forces and open ordered pathways. 6) Conclusion: embodied geometry is a legitimate instrument of Daoist power.","logic_practice":"1) Use paced ritual steps before major BaZi remedial rites to ‘set the grid.’ 2) Train directional awareness (enter/exit, left/right) as luck hygiene in home and altar. 3) Pair breath counts with steps to stabilize intention during exorcistic or blessing work. 4) For clients, translate禹步 logic into daily pathing: avoid chaotic movement in crisis periods. 5) Document which sequences calm a space versus agitate it.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure mental定志 texts, this externalizes logic into footwork. It differs from宅经/葬书 by acting on space through the moving body rather than site selection alone. Relative to mantra scriptures, its primary medium is kinetic pattern, not speech."},{"name_han":"黄帝宅经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that a dwelling is a living yin-yang organism whose form channels qi to occupants; housing is therefore destiny infrastructure. It argues that human fortune is co-authored by residential polarity, proportions, and temporal use, not by personal virtue alone. Therefore correcting the house is a legitimate causal intervention in life outcomes.","logic_chain":"1) Humans dwell continuously inside shaped environments. 2) Environments have yin-yang structure that moves qi. 3) Qi conditions body, emotion, and opportunity timing. 4) Hence dwelling pattern becomes a fate variable. 5) Diagnosing and rebalancing house polarity changes occupant outcomes. 6) Conclusion: residential form is moral-neutral but fate-active; it must be engineered.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi consultation, always couple chart reading with residence audit (light, damp, door-direction, bedroom yin). 2) Sequence: stabilize dwelling qi before expensive personal talismans. 3) Match house adjustments to chart deficiency (e.g., weak earth → ground/stability fixes). 4) Time renovations with luck pillars when possible. 5) Treat chronic family patterns as possibly house-mediated, not only natal.","logic_compare":"Unlike葬书, which works through ancestral burial landscape,宅经 works through the living’s daily container. It differs from star-destiny scriptures by making architecture the medium of fate. Its logic is environmental rather than bureaucratic or purely ethical."},{"name_han":"葬书","logic_thesis":"This text proves that burial landscape stores and transmits ancestral qi to descendants: the dead site is a causal battery for the living line. It argues that wind-water configuration either gathers or scatters this qi, determining generational rise or decline. Therefore geomantic burial is lineage engineering, not mere funeral aesthetics.","logic_chain":"1) Life-qi does not annihilate at death; residual pattern remains land-linked. 2) Terrain either concentrates or disperses that residual qi. 3) Concentrated ancestral qi feeds the bloodline’s fortunes. 4) Scattered qi starves descendants of support and multiplies calamity. 5) Expert siting (藏风得水) optimizes transmission. 6) Conclusion: landscape selection is intergenerational causal design.","logic_practice":"1) For multi-generation BaZi patterns (repeated early death, wealth cliffs), investigate ancestral burial/land factors. 2) Distinguish personal chart faults from lineage-site faults. 3) When burial cannot be changed, use living-house and virtue remedies as partial compensation. 4) Read ‘ancestor luck’ periods as possible site-qi activation windows. 5) Ethical rule: geomancy serves continuity and care, not predatory grave competition.","logic_compare":"Compared with宅经, the subject is the dead’s resting form rather than the living house. Unlike moral scriptures that correct fate by virtue,葬书 corrects fate by terrain physics of qi. It is the classic statement of Chinese lineage geomancy’s causal claim."},{"name_han":"元始天尊说酆都灭罪经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that underworld sin-accounts are administratively real and remediable: guilt is not only psychological but recorded in Fengdu’s judicial machinery. It argues that through revealed rites and the authority of元始天尊, recorded debts can be cancelled or mitigated. Therefore salvation includes bureaucratic petition, not only private remorse.","logic_chain":"1) Moral acts leave records beyond the actor’s mind. 2) Fengdu functions as the archive-court of those records. 3) Unresolved records generate posthumous and descendant suffering. 4) Higher celestial authority can override or purge lower judicial files. 5) Scripture-ritual is the lawful interface for that purge. 6) Conclusion:灭罪 is legal-theurgical operations on real moral debt.","logic_practice":"1) In cases of heavy ‘guilt luck’ or family calamity chains, include confession + underworld-release rites alongside BaZi fixes. 2) Map client suffering to possible unresolved ancestral moral debt, not only elemental imbalance. 3) Practice: periodic灭罪 recitation after major ethical breaches. 4) Separate psychological therapy from Daoist judicial remedy; use both when needed. 5) Track whether merit/repentance work changes recurring chart-triggered disasters.","logic_compare":"Unlike三生解冤, which centers grievance between beings across lives, this text centers state-like underworld bookkeeping. It differs from pure precept texts by offering cancellation technology, not only prevention. Its frame is celestial lawcourt rather than star-registry or geomancy."},{"name_han":"太上老君说五斗金章受生经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that birth and lifespan are issued through the Five Dippers’ golden-seal administration: to be born is to receive a registered endowment. It argues that fortune, debt, and longevity are star-bureau allocations that can be petitioned, repaid, and re-authorized. Therefore destiny work includes stellar bureaucratic negotiation at the point of ‘receiving life.’","logic_chain":"1) Individual life appears with unequal span and lot. 2) Inequality is explained as pre-birth registration under five dipper offices. 3) Registration implies both entitlement and debt. 4) Ritual with金章 addresses the issuing offices. 5) Successful petition rebalances受生 accounts (health, years, protection). 6) Conclusion: life is a granted file; cultivation includes file management.","logic_practice":"1) Read natal BaZi as the visible face of受生 allocation; use五斗 rites when lifespan/health files seem blocked. 2) For birth-year remediation, invoke the relevant dipper correspondence rather than generic prayer. 3) Combine debt repayment ethics (merit, restitution) with star petition. 4) In prenatal/newborn blessing logic, treat registration as ongoing, not one-time. 5) Diagnose chronic ‘cannot receive support’ patterns as possible受生 seal obstruction.","logic_compare":"It is broader than single-dipper scriptures (北/东/西斗) because it frames the five-office system of receiving life. Unlike葬书/宅经, the medium is stellar bureaucracy, not landform. Unlike ethics-only texts, it assumes fate is writable through official celestial seals."},{"name_han":"无上内秘真藏经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that the supreme treasury is internal and secret: true possession is the inward store of Dao, not external implements or status. It argues that outer rites without inner disclosure become empty shells, while inner secrecy protects efficacy from dissipation. Therefore cultivation prioritizes interior authenticity over display.","logic_chain":"1) External techniques can be copied; their power still fails for many. 2) Failure implies a missing non-transferable core. 3) That core is内秘—inner secret realization. 4) True store (真藏) is conserved by non-display and inward refinement. 5) When inner store is full, outer methods work as expressions, not substitutes. 6) Conclusion: soteriological wealth is interior and guarded.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi practice, refuse to treat remedies as external gadgets without client inner change. 2) Build a private cultivation store: breath, stillness, virtue—before public ritual display. 3) Keep certain methods unmonetized/unshown to prevent qi leakage through performance. 4) Evaluate progress by inward stability markers, not only life events. 5) Teach ‘secret integrity’: fewer words, deeper practice.","logic_compare":"Opposite in emphasis to loud spell-and-seal demonological texts that exteriorize power. Differs from moral ledgers by valuing hidden realization over recorded merit counts. Its uniqueness is anti-exhibitionist soteriology: secrecy as causal conservation."},{"name_han":"太上洞渊三昧帝心光明正印太极紫微伏魔制鬼拯救恶道集福吉祥神咒","logic_thesis":"This text proves that luminous authentic seals and spell-power can forcibly reclassify beings from demonic/evil-path states into protected, blessed states. It argues that chaos spirits are not ontologically ultimate; they yield to higher luminous jurisdiction (帝心光明正印/紫微). Therefore ritual speech-seal is a judicial-military technology for rescue and fortune-gathering.","logic_chain":"1) Beings and spaces can be occupied by disordered forces. 2) Disorder persists until a higher lawful authority intervenes. 3) Mantra +正印 transmit that authority as light-jurisdiction. 4) Subjugation (伏魔制鬼) removes obstruction. 5) Removal enables拯救恶道 and集福吉祥 as positive reallocation. 6) Conclusion: spell-seal work is causal re-governance, not mere poetry.","logic_practice":"1) Use only when chart + phenomena indicate oppression/possession patterns, not as casual decoration. 2) Pair recitation with clean altar, moral purification, and fixed intention. 3) After subjugation, install blessing practices so vacuum is not re-invaded. 4) In BaZi terms, treat as intervention for ‘killing/chaos’ periods when ordinary elemental remedies fail. 5) Record before/after symptoms to avoid superstition without feedback.","logic_compare":"Unlike定志 contemplative texts, this is operational exorcistic. Differs from灭罪经 by fighting active demonic agents rather than mainly purging sin files. Compared with禹步, speech-seal dominates over footwork, though both are ritual technologies."},{"name_han":"太上玄灵北斗本命延生真经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that the Northern Dipper is the master registry of本命 and lifespan; aligning with Beidou can extend life and rectify personal destiny. It argues that individual fate is star-administered, so petition timed to one’s destiny correspondence opens a lawful channel for延生. Therefore longevity work is relational: human ↔ Dipper officers.","logic_chain":"1) Personal destiny has a star-correspondence (本命). 2) Beidou governs life-death accounts in Daoist stellar administration. 3) Estrangement from that office manifests as depletion, danger, shortened trajectory. 4) Recitation/rites re-establish recognition and mercy. 5) Recognition yields protection, correction, and life extension. 6) Conclusion: Beidou practice is destiny-account maintenance.","logic_practice":"1) Identify client’s本命 correspondence and observe Beidou ritual calendar. 2) Use for health-span threats, deadly configurations, and major luck collapses. 3) Combine with ethical reform; star mercy without conduct change is unstable. 4) In BaZi, treat strong ‘death/emptiness’ patterns as signals to open Beidou work. 5) Track sleep, crises averted, and vitality as practical KPIs.","logic_compare":"More specifically life-and-destiny focused than the general五斗受生 system framing. Differs from东斗/西斗 by emphasizing lifespan registry and extension rather than mainly protection or name-recording. It is the central personal-fate star scripture in this set."},{"name_han":"太上说东斗护命妙经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that the Eastern Dipper’s specialized function is护命: life-guarding intervention against lethal disruption. It argues that directional star offices have differentiated portfolios, so correctly addressing East Dipper yields protection where generic prayer is diffuse. Therefore precise celestial addressing improves soteriological efficiency.","logic_chain":"1) Crisis types differ (death threat, loss, illness, legal harm). 2) Celestial offices are specialized, not interchangeable. 3) East Dipper’s mandate is life protection. 4) Calling the wrong office wastes ritual force. 5) Right-address petition produces targeted护命 effects. 6) Conclusion: destiny ritual requires functional specificity.","logic_practice":"1) Deploy East Dipper work for acute life-threat windows in chart timing. 2) Pair with medical/practical safety actions; ritual is not a substitute for emergency care. 3) Use as the ‘shield’ module in a multi-dipper protocol. 4) For BaZi clients in accident-prone configurations, schedule protective recitation cycles. 5) Evaluate by reduced crisis frequency in matched periods.","logic_compare":"Unlike Beidou延生’s emphasis on extending and governing lifespan accounts, East Dipper logic is protective guarding. Compared with West Dipper记名, it acts as a shield rather than a registry inscription. Its contribution is portfolio specialization within star bureaucracy."},{"name_han":"太上说西斗记名护身妙经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that being named in the Western Dipper’s register is itself a protective technology: inscription creates recognized status that wards bodily harm. It argues that anonymity before celestial offices leaves the person unshielded, while记名 establishes a file-identity under protection. Therefore salvation includes getting written into the right book.","logic_chain":"1) Protection in bureaucratic cosmos requires recognized identity. 2) West Dipper administers name-recording for body guardianship. 3) Without recording, the person is administratively invisible. 4) Ritual induces记名, converting invisibility into protected status. 5) Protected status reduces bodily calamity and spiritual predation. 6) Conclusion: naming is ontological security work.","logic_practice":"1) Use when clients show ‘unprotected body’ patterns: chronic accidents, invasive misfortune, ritual vulnerability. 2) Integrate name-recording rites with legal/identity hygiene in ordinary life (clear names, clean contracts). 3) Combine with East Dipper protection and Beidou life governance for full coverage. 4) In BaZi, consider for weak self/body element crises. 5) Renew registration at major cycle boundaries.","logic_compare":"Differs from East Dipper by making the act of registration the key mechanism, not only guarding force. Differs from灭罪经: the file written here is protective status, not sin cancellation. Relative to五斗受生, it is the body-protection inscription specialty."},{"name_han":"太上三生解冤妙经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that enmity and blockage are multi-life phenomena: unresolved grievances across three lives bind present fortune. It argues that many current disasters are relational debts, not only elemental weakness, and can be dissolved through dedicated解冤 practice. Therefore fate repair must include intersubjective karmic reconciliation across time.","logic_chain":"1) Present suffering often lacks sufficient same-life explanation. 2) Extending causality across three lives accounts for residual enmity. 3) Grievance creates mutual binding that obstructs luck and health. 4) Ritual and repentance can unbind the enmity knot. 5) Unbinding restores relational freedom and opportunity flow. 6) Conclusion: destiny work requires multi-life conflict resolution.","logic_practice":"1) When BaZi shows repeated interpersonal catastrophes, investigate解冤 before only ‘killing officer’ elemental fixes. 2) Practice confession, restitution, and dedicated recitation for known and unknown adversaries. 3) Include ancestral and ex-relation grievances in the scope. 4) After unbinding, install positive merit to prevent re-knotting. 5) Measure change in recurring enemy/lawsuit/illness-with-conflict patterns.","logic_compare":"Unlike灭罪经’s court-file purge, this targets bilateral resentment between beings. Unlike precept texts that prevent future evil,解冤 remediates already entangled histories. Its distinctive logic is multi-life relational causality."},{"name_han":"太上洞玄灵宝业报因缘经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that moral action operates as systematic cause-and-effect (业报因缘): outcomes are lawful harvests of prior seeds, not arbitrary fate. It argues that understanding dependent origination of karma enables deliberate re-seeding of better results. Therefore ethics is physics of destiny, fully intelligible and trainable.","logic_chain":"1) Events appear linked to prior actions more than to chance. 2) The linking law is业—intentional action leaving consequence. 3) Consequences mature through因缘 conditions, not always instantly. 4) Knowing the law allows intervention at seed and condition stages. 5) Reform of action + creation of new conditions changes harvest. 6) Conclusion: destiny is ethically mechanical and thus reformable.","logic_practice":"1) Translate BaZi ‘bad years’ into likely ripening karmic themes + practical repentance tasks. 2) Build a seed ledger: acts to stop, acts to start, conditions to arrange. 3) Time major good seeds to supportive luck pillars for stronger maturation. 4) Teach delayed maturity: do not judge ethics by same-week results. 5) Use chart reading as map of where causes easily ripen, not as fatal seal.","logic_compare":"More analytic and systemic than single-purpose spell texts. Differs from star-registration scriptures by locating primary causality in moral action rather than stellar filing—though the two can co-exist. It is the doctrinal backbone for karmic BaZi ethics."},{"name_han":"太上说五苦三戒经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that specific sufferings (五苦) are downstream of broken restraints (三戒): ethical boundaries are anti-suffering engineering. It argues that precepts are not arbitrary taboos but causal firewalls; violating them opens predictable misery channels. Therefore liberation begins as disciplined refusal.","logic_chain":"1) Human misery clusters into patterned sufferings. 2) Patterns correlate with recurrent boundary violations. 3) Precepts name the minimal boundaries that close those channels. 4) Holding precepts reduces ignition of五苦. 5) Breaking precepts reopens suffering circuits even if rituals continue. 6) Conclusion: restraint is primary preventive medicine of fate.","logic_practice":"1) Before advanced Daoist or BaZi remedy stacks, install basic precept compliance. 2) Map client’s dominant sufferings to likely precept failures (speech, desire, harm, etc.). 3) Use short, monitorable vows during dangerous luck periods. 4) Treat precept breaks as chart-aggravating events in counseling. 5) Re-enter practice after confession + restraint restart, not denial.","logic_compare":"Unlike灭罪/解冤 that remediate after damage, this is preventive architecture. Differs from contemplative定志 by emphasizing behavioral fences over mental subtlety. Relative to star scriptures, it claims moral restraint can outperform petition if petition lacks conduct."},{"name_han":"太上九天延祥涤邪经","logic_thesis":"This text proves that the Nine Heavens can both extend auspiciousness and wash out evil: celestial hierarchy performs dual purification-and-blessing. It argues that evil qi and inauspicious fate layers are removable contaminants under higher heaven agency, not permanent essence. Therefore ritual ascent logic is cleanse first, then elongate blessing.","logic_chain":"1) Human field mixes auspicious and evil influences. 2) Evil layers block the reception of blessing. 3) Nine Heavens hold authority to涤邪. 4) Once contaminants are washed,延祥 can adhere and lengthen. 5) Combined cleanse+extend yields stable good fortune. 6) Conclusion: auspiciousness is sustainable only after purification.","logic_practice":"1) Sequence remedies as涤邪 → 安定 → 延祥, not blessing-on-top-of-filth. 2) In BaZi disaster years, prioritize purification rites and environment cleanse before wealth rites. 3) Use for chronic ‘dirty luck’ (scandal, infestation, chaotic spirit symptoms). 4) Pair with house cleansing (宅) when evil is spatial. 5) Maintain periodic re-cleansing because fields re-accumulate.","logic_compare":"Broader than single-demon mantras because it unites purification with blessing-extension under九天. Differs from Beidou延生 by focusing on auspicious field hygiene rather than primarily lifespan registry. Its key logic is order-of-operations: cleanse then extend."},{"name_han":"太上赤书玉篇真文","logic_thesis":"This text proves that primordial true writs (赤书玉篇) are world-ordering forces: sacred graphs are not labels of reality but operators that stabilize cosmos against collapse. It argues that correct heavenly text reasserts the original structure of heaven-earth when chaos rises. Therefore scripture-as-talismanic-writing is ontological engineering.","logic_chain":"1) Cosmos can drift toward disorder and catastrophe. 2) At origin, reality was sealed by true writs of highest heaven. 3) Those writs still function as structural code when properly deployed. 4) Deploying赤书玉篇 re-imposes lawful pattern on chaotic conditions. 5) Re-imposed pattern protects beings and reopens correct transformation. 6) Conclusion: true text is causal architecture, not literature alone.","logic_practice":"1) Treat key Lingbao writs as emergency structural remedies in collective or personal chaos phases. 2) In BaZi terms, use when systems fail simultaneously (health+home+social), indicating pattern collapse. 3) Copy/recite/install writs with high ritual purity; form accuracy matters. 4) Combine with personal virtue so the re-ordered field is not immediately re-corrupted. 5) Study writs as cosmology maps that inform chart metaphysics (order, directions, calamity cycles).","logic_compare":"More cosmogonic and structural than moral-precept or underworld-sin texts. Differs from禹步 and mantras by locating primary power in primordial graphs themselves. Relative to commentarial道德集解, it is operative sacred writing rather than interpretive recovery of Laozi."}]}

entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure cosmology texts that explain how the Dao generates the world, this scripture explains the epistemic precondition for knowing that cosmology. It differs from later morality ledgers by locating the bottleneck in will-stability rather than in external merit accounting. Its logic is closer to contemplative Lingbao than to bureaucratic star-registration scriptures.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that filial piety is not merely social etiquette but a cosmic causal law linking personal destiny, literary-official success, and moral credit. It argues that disorder in the parent-child bond disrupts the same hierarchical pattern that governs Heaven’s bureaucracy, so unfilial conduct self-sabotages fate. Therefore Wenchang’s patronage of scholarship is conditional on孝 as the root virtue that authenticates a person before Heaven.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven’s order is hierarchical and reciprocal (Heaven–human, parent–child). 2) The parent–child bond is the nearest enactment of that hierarchy. 3) Violating孝 is not private rudeness but rupture of cosmic pattern. 4) Rupture produces karmic and bureaucratic demerit (blocked luck, failed advancement). 5) Restoring孝 restores alignment and opens Wenchang’s literary-official grace. 6) Conclusion: destiny correction begins at the ethical root of filial relation, not at talent alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi career/exam cases, audit family virtue and unresolved filial debt before only boosting ‘print/resource’ elements. 2) Remediation sequence: repair parent relation / ancestral rites → then study discipline → then Wenchang ritual. 3) Treat literary stars (文昌等) as activated by moral fitness, not as pure technical markers. 4) For clients seeking fame, prescribe concrete孝 acts (care, apology, ancestral offering) as fate work. 5) Read official/academic setbacks as possible hierarchical misalignment signals.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike the Beidou life-extension corpus, which registers fate in stellar bureaus, this text roots fate change in kinship ethics. It differs from generic Confucian孝 texts by making Wenchang a Daoist-administrative guarantor of success. Its logic is moral-causal rather than geomantic or purely contemplative.

entries.name_han: 太上老君虚无自然本起经
entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that existence originates from虚无 and operates by自然: creation is not forced craftsmanship but spontaneous arising from emptiness. It argues that if the root is empty-natural, then forcing form, fame, or power contradicts the generative principle and produces distortion. Therefore true origin-work is returning to non-contrivance, not manufacturing more structure.
entries.logic_chain: 1) What has a beginning must have a prior condition. 2) The prior condition of forms cannot itself be a fixed form, or regress continues. 3) Hence root is虚无: open potential without rigid identity. 4) From that root, arising is自然—unforced, pattern-true. 5) Human striving that violates spontaneity creates false starts and karmic knots. 6) Conclusion: origin recovery = emptiness-aligned non-contrivance.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, diagnose over-control: when charts or lives are ‘over-engineered,’ restore flow before adding more 补泻. 2) Cultivation: practice wuwei intervals—act only when qi is ready, not from anxiety. 3) For natal reading, privilege spontaneous constitution (day-master ecology) over client wish-projection. 4) Use emptiness meditation to reset desire-driven luck chasing. 5) Prefer remedies that remove obstruction over remedies that force outcomes.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with ritual-registration scriptures (五斗、北斗), this is ontological rather than bureaucratic. It differs from change-focused texts by asking ‘what is the origin?’ not ‘how do forms transform?’ Its force is metaphysical grounding for all later practice.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that change is the operative law of the Dao: identity is processive, so clinging to fixed form is ignorance of reality’s mechanism. It argues that sagehood consists in riding transformations rather than freezing a preferred state. Therefore longevity and power come from plasticity aligned with Dao, not from resisting flux.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Observed world continuously transforms. 2) If Dao were static substance only, it could not generate or govern change. 3) Therefore Dao’s efficacy is变化. 4) Beings fail when they reify temporary phases as permanent selves. 5) Aligning with transformation yields survival, efficacy, and spiritual mobility. 6) Conclusion: mastery = lawful participation in change, not escape from it.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read BaZi as phase dynamics (大运/流年) not as a frozen personality label. 2) Teach clients to change strategy at luck-pillar boundaries rather than force old methods. 3) Cultivation: practice form-shifting methods (breath, posture, role) without losing center. 4) In remedy design, prefer adaptive protocols over one-shot talismans. 5) Track life as transformation sequences: what must die for the next phase to live.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike本起经’s focus on origin-from-emptiness, this text focuses on mid-stream metamorphosis. It differs from pure ethics scriptures by treating change itself as soteriological technology. Relative to geomancy, it interiorizes flux as spiritual law rather than landscape law.

entries.name_han: 道德真经四子古道集解
entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that the Dao De Jing’s authority is recovered through a multi-master ‘ancient way’ hermeneutic: truth is clarified by convergent classical commentary, not private novelty. It argues that later distortions are corrected by returning to four-lineage collective reading that preserves the old path. Therefore orthodoxy is a disciplined interpretive community practice.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Core scripture can be misread when isolated from living transmission. 2) Multiple classical masters preserve different angles of one Dao. 3) Collective collation filters sectarian drift and linguistic decay. 4) Convergent sense across four masters indicates ‘古道’. 5) Practice guided by that reconstructed sense is more reliable than fashionable exegesis. 6) Conclusion: interpretive fidelity is itself a cultivation method.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When applying Laozi to BaZi ethics, cross-check at least two classical commentarial lines before modern self-help readings. 2) Build a personal ‘four-source’ rule: classic + commentary + practice log + outcome. 3) Reject chart theories that cannot be traced to coherent Dao principles. 4) Use collective study (lineage/group reading) to prevent solo delusion. 5) Treat textual study as jing-qi-shen work: quiet mind → parse → embody.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-revelation Lingbao or star scriptures, this is meta-textual: it argues how to read. It differs from apocryphal spell texts by locating power in interpretive discipline rather than mantra efficacy. Its uniqueness is orthodoxy-as-method.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that ritual locomotion (禹步) is a causal technology: the body can enact cosmic numerology (三五) and thereby re-order spiritual space. It argues that stepping patterns are not theater but encoded correspondence between human movement and celestial-terrestrial grids. Therefore right pace and sequence can bind demons, open paths, and align qi.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Cosmos has measurable patterns (three-five numerology, directions, gates). 2) Human body can map those patterns through structured movement. 3) Mapping is not symbolic only; it establishes operational correspondence. 4) Operational correspondence reallocates spiritual authority in a space. 5) Thus禹步 can constrain chaotic forces and open ordered pathways. 6) Conclusion: embodied geometry is a legitimate instrument of Daoist power.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use paced ritual steps before major BaZi remedial rites to ‘set the grid.’ 2) Train directional awareness (enter/exit, left/right) as luck hygiene in home and altar. 3) Pair breath counts with steps to stabilize intention during exorcistic or blessing work. 4) For clients, translate禹步 logic into daily pathing: avoid chaotic movement in crisis periods. 5) Document which sequences calm a space versus agitate it.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure mental定志 texts, this externalizes logic into footwork. It differs from宅经/葬书 by acting on space through the moving body rather than site selection alone. Relative to mantra scriptures, its primary medium is kinetic pattern, not speech.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that a dwelling is a living yin-yang organism whose form channels qi to occupants; housing is therefore destiny infrastructure. It argues that human fortune is co-authored by residential polarity, proportions, and temporal use, not by personal virtue alone. Therefore correcting the house is a legitimate causal intervention in life outcomes.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Humans dwell continuously inside shaped environments. 2) Environments have yin-yang structure that moves qi. 3) Qi conditions body, emotion, and opportunity timing. 4) Hence dwelling pattern becomes a fate variable. 5) Diagnosing and rebalancing house polarity changes occupant outcomes. 6) Conclusion: residential form is moral-neutral but fate-active; it must be engineered.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi consultation, always couple chart reading with residence audit (light, damp, door-direction, bedroom yin). 2) Sequence: stabilize dwelling qi before expensive personal talismans. 3) Match house adjustments to chart deficiency (e.g., weak earth → ground/stability fixes). 4) Time renovations with luck pillars when possible. 5) Treat chronic family patterns as possibly house-mediated, not only natal.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike葬书, which works through ancestral burial landscape,宅经 works through the living’s daily container. It differs from star-destiny scriptures by making architecture the medium of fate. Its logic is environmental rather than bureaucratic or purely ethical.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that burial landscape stores and transmits ancestral qi to descendants: the dead site is a causal battery for the living line. It argues that wind-water configuration either gathers or scatters this qi, determining generational rise or decline. Therefore geomantic burial is lineage engineering, not mere funeral aesthetics.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Life-qi does not annihilate at death; residual pattern remains land-linked. 2) Terrain either concentrates or disperses that residual qi. 3) Concentrated ancestral qi feeds the bloodline’s fortunes. 4) Scattered qi starves descendants of support and multiplies calamity. 5) Expert siting (藏风得水) optimizes transmission. 6) Conclusion: landscape selection is intergenerational causal design.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For multi-generation BaZi patterns (repeated early death, wealth cliffs), investigate ancestral burial/land factors. 2) Distinguish personal chart faults from lineage-site faults. 3) When burial cannot be changed, use living-house and virtue remedies as partial compensation. 4) Read ‘ancestor luck’ periods as possible site-qi activation windows. 5) Ethical rule: geomancy serves continuity and care, not predatory grave competition.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with宅经, the subject is the dead’s resting form rather than the living house. Unlike moral scriptures that correct fate by virtue,葬书 corrects fate by terrain physics of qi. It is the classic statement of Chinese lineage geomancy’s causal claim.

entries.name_han: 元始天尊说酆都灭罪经
entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that underworld sin-accounts are administratively real and remediable: guilt is not only psychological but recorded in Fengdu’s judicial machinery. It argues that through revealed rites and the authority of元始天尊, recorded debts can be cancelled or mitigated. Therefore salvation includes bureaucratic petition, not only private remorse.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Moral acts leave records beyond the actor’s mind. 2) Fengdu functions as the archive-court of those records. 3) Unresolved records generate posthumous and descendant suffering. 4) Higher celestial authority can override or purge lower judicial files. 5) Scripture-ritual is the lawful interface for that purge. 6) Conclusion:灭罪 is legal-theurgical operations on real moral debt.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In cases of heavy ‘guilt luck’ or family calamity chains, include confession + underworld-release rites alongside BaZi fixes. 2) Map client suffering to possible unresolved ancestral moral debt, not only elemental imbalance. 3) Practice: periodic灭罪 recitation after major ethical breaches. 4) Separate psychological therapy from Daoist judicial remedy; use both when needed. 5) Track whether merit/repentance work changes recurring chart-triggered disasters.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike三生解冤, which centers grievance between beings across lives, this text centers state-like underworld bookkeeping. It differs from pure precept texts by offering cancellation technology, not only prevention. Its frame is celestial lawcourt rather than star-registry or geomancy.

entries.name_han: 太上老君说五斗金章受生经
entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that birth and lifespan are issued through the Five Dippers’ golden-seal administration: to be born is to receive a registered endowment. It argues that fortune, debt, and longevity are star-bureau allocations that can be petitioned, repaid, and re-authorized. Therefore destiny work includes stellar bureaucratic negotiation at the point of ‘receiving life.’
entries.logic_chain: 1) Individual life appears with unequal span and lot. 2) Inequality is explained as pre-birth registration under five dipper offices. 3) Registration implies both entitlement and debt. 4) Ritual with金章 addresses the issuing offices. 5) Successful petition rebalances受生 accounts (health, years, protection). 6) Conclusion: life is a granted file; cultivation includes file management.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read natal BaZi as the visible face of受生 allocation; use五斗 rites when lifespan/health files seem blocked. 2) For birth-year remediation, invoke the relevant dipper correspondence rather than generic prayer. 3) Combine debt repayment ethics (merit, restitution) with star petition. 4) In prenatal/newborn blessing logic, treat registration as ongoing, not one-time. 5) Diagnose chronic ‘cannot receive support’ patterns as possible受生 seal obstruction.
entries.logic_compare: It is broader than single-dipper scriptures (北/东/西斗) because it frames the five-office system of receiving life. Unlike葬书/宅经, the medium is stellar bureaucracy, not landform. Unlike ethics-only texts, it assumes fate is writable through official celestial seals.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that the supreme treasury is internal and secret: true possession is the inward store of Dao, not external implements or status. It argues that outer rites without inner disclosure become empty shells, while inner secrecy protects efficacy from dissipation. Therefore cultivation prioritizes interior authenticity over display.
entries.logic_chain: 1) External techniques can be copied; their power still fails for many. 2) Failure implies a missing non-transferable core. 3) That core is内秘—inner secret realization. 4) True store (真藏) is conserved by non-display and inward refinement. 5) When inner store is full, outer methods work as expressions, not substitutes. 6) Conclusion: soteriological wealth is interior and guarded.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi practice, refuse to treat remedies as external gadgets without client inner change. 2) Build a private cultivation store: breath, stillness, virtue—before public ritual display. 3) Keep certain methods unmonetized/unshown to prevent qi leakage through performance. 4) Evaluate progress by inward stability markers, not only life events. 5) Teach ‘secret integrity’: fewer words, deeper practice.
entries.logic_compare: Opposite in emphasis to loud spell-and-seal demonological texts that exteriorize power. Differs from moral ledgers by valuing hidden realization over recorded merit counts. Its uniqueness is anti-exhibitionist soteriology: secrecy as causal conservation.

entries.name_han: 太上洞渊三昧帝心光明正印太极紫微伏魔制鬼拯救恶道集福吉祥神咒
entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that luminous authentic seals and spell-power can forcibly reclassify beings from demonic/evil-path states into protected, blessed states. It argues that chaos spirits are not ontologically ultimate; they yield to higher luminous jurisdiction (帝心光明正印/紫微). Therefore ritual speech-seal is a judicial-military technology for rescue and fortune-gathering.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Beings and spaces can be occupied by disordered forces. 2) Disorder persists until a higher lawful authority intervenes. 3) Mantra +正印 transmit that authority as light-jurisdiction. 4) Subjugation (伏魔制鬼) removes obstruction. 5) Removal enables拯救恶道 and集福吉祥 as positive reallocation. 6) Conclusion: spell-seal work is causal re-governance, not mere poetry.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use only when chart + phenomena indicate oppression/possession patterns, not as casual decoration. 2) Pair recitation with clean altar, moral purification, and fixed intention. 3) After subjugation, install blessing practices so vacuum is not re-invaded. 4) In BaZi terms, treat as intervention for ‘killing/chaos’ periods when ordinary elemental remedies fail. 5) Record before/after symptoms to avoid superstition without feedback.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike定志 contemplative texts, this is operational exorcistic. Differs from灭罪经 by fighting active demonic agents rather than mainly purging sin files. Compared with禹步, speech-seal dominates over footwork, though both are ritual technologies.

entries.name_han: 太上玄灵北斗本命延生真经
entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that the Northern Dipper is the master registry of本命 and lifespan; aligning with Beidou can extend life and rectify personal destiny. It argues that individual fate is star-administered, so petition timed to one’s destiny correspondence opens a lawful channel for延生. Therefore longevity work is relational: human ↔ Dipper officers.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Personal destiny has a star-correspondence (本命). 2) Beidou governs life-death accounts in Daoist stellar administration. 3) Estrangement from that office manifests as depletion, danger, shortened trajectory. 4) Recitation/rites re-establish recognition and mercy. 5) Recognition yields protection, correction, and life extension. 6) Conclusion: Beidou practice is destiny-account maintenance.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Identify client’s本命 correspondence and observe Beidou ritual calendar. 2) Use for health-span threats, deadly configurations, and major luck collapses. 3) Combine with ethical reform; star mercy without conduct change is unstable. 4) In BaZi, treat strong ‘death/emptiness’ patterns as signals to open Beidou work. 5) Track sleep, crises averted, and vitality as practical KPIs.
entries.logic_compare: More specifically life-and-destiny focused than the general五斗受生 system framing. Differs from东斗/西斗 by emphasizing lifespan registry and extension rather than mainly protection or name-recording. It is the central personal-fate star scripture in this set.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that the Eastern Dipper’s specialized function is护命: life-guarding intervention against lethal disruption. It argues that directional star offices have differentiated portfolios, so correctly addressing East Dipper yields protection where generic prayer is diffuse. Therefore precise celestial addressing improves soteriological efficiency.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Crisis types differ (death threat, loss, illness, legal harm). 2) Celestial offices are specialized, not interchangeable. 3) East Dipper’s mandate is life protection. 4) Calling the wrong office wastes ritual force. 5) Right-address petition produces targeted护命 effects. 6) Conclusion: destiny ritual requires functional specificity.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Deploy East Dipper work for acute life-threat windows in chart timing. 2) Pair with medical/practical safety actions; ritual is not a substitute for emergency care. 3) Use as the ‘shield’ module in a multi-dipper protocol. 4) For BaZi clients in accident-prone configurations, schedule protective recitation cycles. 5) Evaluate by reduced crisis frequency in matched periods.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Beidou延生’s emphasis on extending and governing lifespan accounts, East Dipper logic is protective guarding. Compared with West Dipper记名, it acts as a shield rather than a registry inscription. Its contribution is portfolio specialization within star bureaucracy.

entries.name_han: 太上说西斗记名护身妙经
entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that being named in the Western Dipper’s register is itself a protective technology: inscription creates recognized status that wards bodily harm. It argues that anonymity before celestial offices leaves the person unshielded, while记名 establishes a file-identity under protection. Therefore salvation includes getting written into the right book.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Protection in bureaucratic cosmos requires recognized identity. 2) West Dipper administers name-recording for body guardianship. 3) Without recording, the person is administratively invisible. 4) Ritual induces记名, converting invisibility into protected status. 5) Protected status reduces bodily calamity and spiritual predation. 6) Conclusion: naming is ontological security work.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use when clients show ‘unprotected body’ patterns: chronic accidents, invasive misfortune, ritual vulnerability. 2) Integrate name-recording rites with legal/identity hygiene in ordinary life (clear names, clean contracts). 3) Combine with East Dipper protection and Beidou life governance for full coverage. 4) In BaZi, consider for weak self/body element crises. 5) Renew registration at major cycle boundaries.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from East Dipper by making the act of registration the key mechanism, not only guarding force. Differs from灭罪经: the file written here is protective status, not sin cancellation. Relative to五斗受生, it is the body-protection inscription specialty.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that enmity and blockage are multi-life phenomena: unresolved grievances across three lives bind present fortune. It argues that many current disasters are relational debts, not only elemental weakness, and can be dissolved through dedicated解冤 practice. Therefore fate repair must include intersubjective karmic reconciliation across time.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Present suffering often lacks sufficient same-life explanation. 2) Extending causality across three lives accounts for residual enmity. 3) Grievance creates mutual binding that obstructs luck and health. 4) Ritual and repentance can unbind the enmity knot. 5) Unbinding restores relational freedom and opportunity flow. 6) Conclusion: destiny work requires multi-life conflict resolution.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When BaZi shows repeated interpersonal catastrophes, investigate解冤 before only ‘killing officer’ elemental fixes. 2) Practice confession, restitution, and dedicated recitation for known and unknown adversaries. 3) Include ancestral and ex-relation grievances in the scope. 4) After unbinding, install positive merit to prevent re-knotting. 5) Measure change in recurring enemy/lawsuit/illness-with-conflict patterns.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike灭罪经’s court-file purge, this targets bilateral resentment between beings. Unlike precept texts that prevent future evil,解冤 remediates already entangled histories. Its distinctive logic is multi-life relational causality.

entries.name_han: 太上洞玄灵宝业报因缘经
entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that moral action operates as systematic cause-and-effect (业报因缘): outcomes are lawful harvests of prior seeds, not arbitrary fate. It argues that understanding dependent origination of karma enables deliberate re-seeding of better results. Therefore ethics is physics of destiny, fully intelligible and trainable.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Events appear linked to prior actions more than to chance. 2) The linking law is业—intentional action leaving consequence. 3) Consequences mature through因缘 conditions, not always instantly. 4) Knowing the law allows intervention at seed and condition stages. 5) Reform of action + creation of new conditions changes harvest. 6) Conclusion: destiny is ethically mechanical and thus reformable.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Translate BaZi ‘bad years’ into likely ripening karmic themes + practical repentance tasks. 2) Build a seed ledger: acts to stop, acts to start, conditions to arrange. 3) Time major good seeds to supportive luck pillars for stronger maturation. 4) Teach delayed maturity: do not judge ethics by same-week results. 5) Use chart reading as map of where causes easily ripen, not as fatal seal.
entries.logic_compare: More analytic and systemic than single-purpose spell texts. Differs from star-registration scriptures by locating primary causality in moral action rather than stellar filing—though the two can co-exist. It is the doctrinal backbone for karmic BaZi ethics.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that specific sufferings (五苦) are downstream of broken restraints (三戒): ethical boundaries are anti-suffering engineering. It argues that precepts are not arbitrary taboos but causal firewalls; violating them opens predictable misery channels. Therefore liberation begins as disciplined refusal.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Human misery clusters into patterned sufferings. 2) Patterns correlate with recurrent boundary violations. 3) Precepts name the minimal boundaries that close those channels. 4) Holding precepts reduces ignition of五苦. 5) Breaking precepts reopens suffering circuits even if rituals continue. 6) Conclusion: restraint is primary preventive medicine of fate.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before advanced Daoist or BaZi remedy stacks, install basic precept compliance. 2) Map client’s dominant sufferings to likely precept failures (speech, desire, harm, etc.). 3) Use short, monitorable vows during dangerous luck periods. 4) Treat precept breaks as chart-aggravating events in counseling. 5) Re-enter practice after confession + restraint restart, not denial.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike灭罪/解冤 that remediate after damage, this is preventive architecture. Differs from contemplative定志 by emphasizing behavioral fences over mental subtlety. Relative to star scriptures, it claims moral restraint can outperform petition if petition lacks conduct.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that the Nine Heavens can both extend auspiciousness and wash out evil: celestial hierarchy performs dual purification-and-blessing. It argues that evil qi and inauspicious fate layers are removable contaminants under higher heaven agency, not permanent essence. Therefore ritual ascent logic is cleanse first, then elongate blessing.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Human field mixes auspicious and evil influences. 2) Evil layers block the reception of blessing. 3) Nine Heavens hold authority to涤邪. 4) Once contaminants are washed,延祥 can adhere and lengthen. 5) Combined cleanse+extend yields stable good fortune. 6) Conclusion: auspiciousness is sustainable only after purification.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Sequence remedies as涤邪 → 安定 → 延祥, not blessing-on-top-of-filth. 2) In BaZi disaster years, prioritize purification rites and environment cleanse before wealth rites. 3) Use for chronic ‘dirty luck’ (scandal, infestation, chaotic spirit symptoms). 4) Pair with house cleansing (宅) when evil is spatial. 5) Maintain periodic re-cleansing because fields re-accumulate.
entries.logic_compare: Broader than single-demon mantras because it unites purification with blessing-extension under九天. Differs from Beidou延生 by focusing on auspicious field hygiene rather than primarily lifespan registry. Its key logic is order-of-operations: cleanse then extend.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that primordial true writs (赤书玉篇) are world-ordering forces: sacred graphs are not labels of reality but operators that stabilize cosmos against collapse. It argues that correct heavenly text reasserts the original structure of heaven-earth when chaos rises. Therefore scripture-as-talismanic-writing is ontological engineering.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Cosmos can drift toward disorder and catastrophe. 2) At origin, reality was sealed by true writs of highest heaven. 3) Those writs still function as structural code when properly deployed. 4) Deploying赤书玉篇 re-imposes lawful pattern on chaotic conditions. 5) Re-imposed pattern protects beings and reopens correct transformation. 6) Conclusion: true text is causal architecture, not literature alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat key Lingbao writs as emergency structural remedies in collective or personal chaos phases. 2) In BaZi terms, use when systems fail simultaneously (health+home+social), indicating pattern collapse. 3) Copy/recite/install writs with high ritual purity; form accuracy matters. 4) Combine with personal virtue so the re-ordered field is not immediately re-corrupted. 5) Study writs as cosmology maps that inform chart metaphysics (order, directions, calamity cycles).
entries.logic_compare: More cosmogonic and structural than moral-precept or underworld-sin texts. Differs from禹步 and mantras by locating primary power in primordial graphs themselves. Relative to commentarial道德集解, it is operative sacred writing rather than interpretive recovery of Laozi.
